title: Louisiana appeals court revives father's will after six of his nine children challenge signatures
summary_full: A contentious family feud arose when six of a father's nine children contested the legitimacy of his will, arguing discrepancies in signatures and the execution process. However, after legal deliberations, an appeals court overturned the initial ruling that declared the will invalid, citing insufficient evidence from the challengers. This ruling paves the way for the succession process to proceed under fresh legal stipulations.
